user.title: Bambu Filament Manager
user.description:
Printers found: {printers}.

Finish the setup or add another printer?

printer.title: Connect printer
printer.description:
You find these on the printer:
• **IP address and access code:** Settings → Network / WLAN (on P1/A1/P2S in the “LAN mode” menu).
• **Serial number:** Settings → device info, or in Bambu Studio / Handy.

Tip: give the printer a fixed IP address in your router.

install_bambu.title: Bambu Lab integration missing
install_bambu.description:
The printer connection is handled by the **Bambu Lab** integration (ha-bambulab). To install it:

1. [Open Bambu Lab in the Marketplace]({link}) → **Download**.
2. **Restart** Home Assistant.
3. Open this setup again – then you only enter IP, serial number and access code.

error.printer_already_configured: This printer is already set up.
error.bambu_missing: The Bambu Lab integration is not installed yet (restart Home Assistant after installing it).

error.cannot_connect_local_incorrect_serial: The serial number does not match this printer.
error.cannot_connect_local_incorrect_address: Connection refused – is the IP address right?
error.cannot_connect_local_address_unreachable: The IP address cannot be reached.
error.bambu_flow_unexpected: The Bambu Lab integration answered unexpectedly. Please add the printer directly in Bambu Lab.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Messages are sent to all selected targets (text only). The list shows every notification service set up in your Home Assistant – e.g. mobile app, Telegram or WhatsApp if installed.

data.notify_scan: Message when a spool is scanned

data_description.ignored_tags: Stickers you named yourself in HA are ignored anyway. Add automatically named ones (“Tag …”) here if they belong to something else (e.g. a door).
data_description.default_spool_weight: Used to compute the rest when weighing (scale shows filament + spool).

weigh_spool.name: Weigh spool
